prose: What connects Christianity, Tarot, and the stars? In Astrotheology 101, Chance Garton joins Meg Moonbeam to explore celestial symbolism in biblical stories, sacred art, and nursery rhymes.
Why do a man, an eagle, a bull, and a lion appear around Christ, represent the four evangelists, and occupy the corners of the World and Wheel of Fortune tarot cards?
topics: Mother Goose, “Hey Diddle Diddle,” and the constellations
Cygnus the Swan, sacred geese, and initiation symbolism
The tetramorph: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John
The four Royal Stars and the seven lamps of Revelation
ext: Jesus and solar symbolism, the Sacred Heart and Leo, the Lamb and Aries, Virgo and the virgin birth, Mary as Stella Maris, and Venus, Moses, and Miriam.
